blocks.text: [ Principle 10 ]
Principle 10: My school life
(My Childhood)
When I was young I liked to play with my friends.
We always played late into the night and when I got home my mother sometimes scolded me.
My mother said I was a troublemaker and I was accident-prone too.
(My Youth Life)
When I was younger I really liked actors and singers.
On the weekend I would go to the movies or see concerts.
I entered puberty early and would was very interested in boys.
I spent my teenager years just like any other girl did.
I worked hard to get into a good University.
(My Best School Days)
My High school life was very special; I made a lot of friends there.
During that time I made friends that I still have today.
We usually meet once a month to catch up on each other’s lives.
We save money and like to go on trips together.
(My University Life)
When I was in High School I had a dream to be a teacher.
I went to University and studied Education.
But I couldn’t become a teacher because I didn’t study hard enough.
I still think about my failure to fulfill that dream.
I continue to study and hopefully one day I will be able to teach.
